verdict.rationale: PostHog's own pipeline feature can batch export large amounts of data to your warehouse, and a user reports exporting data from a SQL insight, so a first-party export path exists. The evidence does not show complete account export or name any open file formats. missing for 10: documented full-account export of all data types (events, persons, recordings, configs), explicit open formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet/JSON), offboarding/migration guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: batch export large amounts to your warehouse
they had to export data from a SQL insight instead
